title: (0Day) Kenwood DMX958XR Firmware Update Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows physically present attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Kenwood DMX958XR devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the firmware update process. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
